guide_solution: (a) E-mail is a wonderful invention and it plays an important role in business and communication. (b) This is a scientific way of sending messages, data and information files within a few seconds. (c) Communication through email is made between two persons or offices and the receiver is not required to remain present simultaneously like telephone. (d) To operate an email system, we need two sets of computers and the Internet connection. (e) E-mail functions instantly with the help of a computer set, android mobile phone and tab which are connected in a network.
